newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - SBC Warburg cuts UK property stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SBC Warburg cuts UK property stocks.

text.p: Land Securities Plc, British Land Plc and Slough Estates Plc were cut to "hold" from "add" at SBC Warburg, market sources said on Thursday.

Dealers noted that the downgrades came ahead of results from Land Securities and other leading companies but said the move was no more than a response to recent outperformance by leading shares in the sector.
Land Securities for instance set a record 812p in early trade on Thursday before easing back to be up 4p at 805-1/2 by 1244 GMT.
Analysts at the brokerage declined comment.
